script.author: GISNT
script.description: Distance (km) on Graphical Assignment emergency recommendations

check_query.query: select 1 from maxattribute where objectname = 'SKDEMAVAILRES' and attributename = 'DISTANCEKM'

freeform.description: Distance column in the Emergency Work Resource Availability list
freeform.sql: update maxpresentation set presentation = replace(presentation, '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/>', '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/><tablecol dataattribute="distancekm" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_distkm"/>') where app in ('RLASSIGN', 'RLCAPACITY', 'GWORKASSIGN') and dbms_lob.instr(presentation, 'runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_distkm') = 0 and dbms_lob.instr(presentation, '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/>') > 0

update maxpresentation set presentation = replace(presentation, '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/>', '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/><tablecol dataattribute="distancekm" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_distkm"/>') where app in ('RLASSIGN', 'RLCAPACITY', 'GWORKASSIGN') and locate('runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_distkm', presentation) = 0 and locate('<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/>', presentation) > 0

update maxpresentation set presentation = replace(cast(presentation as varchar(max)), '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/>', '<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/><tablecol dataattribute="distancekm" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_distkm"/>') where app in ('RLASSIGN', 'RLCAPACITY', 'GWORKASSIGN') and charindex('runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_distkm', cast(presentation as varchar(max))) = 0 and charindex('<tablecol dataattribute="traveltime" id="runemrg_assignments_table_tablebody_travtime"/>', cast(presentation as varchar(max))) > 0

update maxpresentation set presentation = replace(presentation, '<textbox dataattribute="traveltime" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_51"/>', '<textbox dataattribute="traveltime" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_51"/><textbox dataattribute="distancekm" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_52"/>') where app in ('RLASSIGN', 'RLCAPACITY', 'GWORKASSIGN') and locate('emwo_preview_1_grid7_52', presentation) = 0 and locate('<textbox dataattribute="traveltime" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_51"/>', presentation) > 0

update maxpresentation set presentation = replace(cast(presentation as varchar(max)), '<textbox dataattribute="traveltime" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_51"/>', '<textbox dataattribute="traveltime" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_51"/><textbox dataattribute="distancekm" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_52"/>') where app in ('RLASSIGN', 'RLCAPACITY', 'GWORKASSIGN') and charindex('emwo_preview_1_grid7_52', cast(presentation as varchar(max))) = 0 and charindex('<textbox dataattribute="traveltime" id="emwo_preview_1_grid7_51"/>', cast(presentation as varchar(max))) > 0
